🖥 Muscat meeting to focus on new maritime arrangements in Strait of Hormuz: Araghchi

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says the upcoming regional meeting in Muscat will focus exclusively on establishing new maritime arrangements in the Strait of Hormuz.

In an interview with the London-based Arabic-language news outlet Al-Araby Al-Jadeed, Araghchi said the joint meeting between Iran, its six southern neighbors and Iraq in Muscat will focus exclusively on new maritime arrangements in the Strait of Hormuz.
​
He added that Iran and Oman have agreed to establish the new route and have prepared the relevant maps and a joint statement. The top Iranian diplomat said the details of the agreement and the maps will be presented to the participating countries and then submitted to the International Maritime Organization (IMO) for registration.
​
Araghchi stressed that the Iran-Oman agreement does not mean the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Rather, it sets out the framework and arrangements for maritime traffic should conditions for reopening the strait be met. The agreement also specifies the new entry and exit routes through the Strait of Hormuz, he added.
​
He said that the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is conditional on the United States returning to and fulfilling its commitments under the Islamabad memorandum of understanding (MoU).
​
Araghchi added that Iran is committed to ensuring the security of maritime traffic, but considers US actions, including the naval blockade and economic warfare, the main cause of insecurity. The Iran-Oman agreement only establishes the framework and new maritime routes, which could serve as the basis for restoring normal traffic through the strait if Iran’s conditions are met, Araghchi underlined.
​
The top diplomat said Iran believes that regional security and stability should be ensured by the countries of the region themselves, without interference by foreign actors, stressing dialogue, confidence-building and cooperation among neighbors.
​
However, he said the upcoming meeting is not aimed at establishing a new regional security mechanism, and such a mechanism is not on its agenda. He described the meeting as a confidence-building step that could, if sustained, pave the way for regional cooperation on other issues and reduce external interference.
​
Araghchi also said that the Muscat meeting is not intended to address the Yemen conflict or resolve disputes among regional countries, with its agenda limited to the new maritime arrangements in the Strait of Hormuz. Nevertheless, he said direct dialogue among regional countries could improve mutual understanding, reduce misunderstandings and help manage tensions.
​
Regarding Yemen, he reiterated Iran’s position that there is no military solution and that the country’s future should be determined through Yemeni dialogue and an inclusive political process.

📄 Man Utd vs Man City: Manchester Derby – team news, lineups

📌 Manchester United vs Manchester City preview: latest team news, injuries, predicted lineups, form, and how to watch the Premier League derby at Old Trafford.

The first Manchester derby of the 2026-27 Premier League season arrives with Manchester United desperate to turn renewed confidence into a statement result against their local rivals. Michael Carrick's side have taken only four points from their opening three league games and conceded twice in each match, but Thursday's 4-0 Champions League victory over Sabah provided a timely response. Manchester City arrive in considerably stronger league form, having won all three of their Premier League matches and all four competitive games under Enzo Maresca. Yet Old Trafford has already produced one of the biggest moments of Carrick's reign, with United beating City 2-0 in January. With Erling Haaland in prolific form and United still deciding between Benjamin Šeško and Matheus Cunha in attack, the latest Manchester United vs Manchester City clash has several major tactical and selection questions attached to it.
​
Michael Carrick has several important decisions to make before the derby, with the biggest uncertainty coming in attack.
​
Marcus Rashford was an unused substitute in United's Champions League victory over Sabah, but the supplied team news expects him to return to the starting XI after his encouraging performance against Everton.
​
Luke Shaw is another key selection question. The left-back missed the Sabah match after suffering cramp, but Carrick indicated that the issue was not considered a major setback. Shaw is still expected to undergo a late fitness test.
​
United's confirmed injury concerns include:
​
If Shaw cannot play, Patrick Dorgu is expected to take his place at left-back.
​
The main tactical dilemma is further forward. Šeško and Cunha provide completely different options, with Šeško offering a more traditional No. 9 presence while Cunha can operate as a false nine and move into deeper areas.
​
City enter the derby with a considerably shorter injury list.
​
Jérémy Doku is the main absentee, with the winger still unavailable. Antoine Semenyo is therefore expected to start on the left.
​
Elliot Anderson should return to the starting midfield after appearing from the bench against Porto, with Ayyoub Bouaddi expected to make way.
​
Phil Foden is also expected to keep his place on the right despite competition from Iliman Ndiaye.
​
Nico O'Reilly has returned to full fitness, although the supplied prediction has him starting on the bench.
​
The biggest selection battle for Carrick is the No. 9 position.
​
Cunha's movement could be particularly valuable against City's centre-backs because he is capable of dropping into midfield and pulling defenders away from their defensive positions. Šeško offers a more direct alternative, attacking the space behind the defensive line and giving United a stronger focal point inside the penalty area.
​
The supplied predicted XI has Cunha starting centrally, with Rashford returning on the left and Bryan Mbeumo on the right.
​
Lammens; Dalot, Maguire, Martínez, Shaw; Tielemans, Mainoo; Mbeumo, Fernandes, Rashford; Cunha.
​
If Shaw fails his fitness test, Dorgu is expected to replace him.
​
Maresca has fewer selection problems to solve. The central midfield should see Anderson restored alongside Enzo Fernández, while Foden is expected to continue on the right.
​
Haaland remains the obvious focal point at centre-forward.  . . .
